name: civsim
description: Repo task runner. Thin aliases over cargo (Rust) and the web app's own bun scripts (bun run --cwd web ...); no dependencies of its own. cargo and web/package.json stay the source of truth. Convention: a bare script runs the WHOLE job across every submodule (build, test, fmt); a :suffix runs one named part (build:wasm, test:web).

scripts.build: bun run build:wasm && bun run build:web
scripts.fmt: bun run fmt:rust && bun run fmt:web
scripts.fmt:check: cargo fmt --all -- --check && bun run --cwd web format:check
scripts.test: bun run test:rust && bun run test:web
scripts.test:web: bun run --cwd web test && bun run --cwd web test:ui && bun run --cwd web test:unit
scripts.check: bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
